search.query: "Freeman Medical Center" Freeman SD Avera hospital price transparency standard charges
search.basis: freemanregional.com is the first-party site of Freeman Regional Health Services (510 E 8th St, Freeman, SD 57029), the parent of Freeman Medical Center per locations.avera.org/freeman-regional-health-services. avera.org remains the system publisher domain hosting the price-transparency page and CSVs.

access_recheck.reason: Prior denial was via headless browser; probed a materially different access path (plain HTTP GET with browser User-Agent, Range 0-262143).
access_recheck.note: A 403 to automated access is not evidence of file absence or noncompliance.

first_party_site_links.result: The first-party site's only price-transparency lead is the MyChart guest estimator; no CSV/JSON MRF link is exposed.

established: freemanregional.com exists as a first-party facility site and exposes no machine-readable standard-charges file, only the estimator.
The exact avera.org Freeman CSV remains access-denied (HTTP 403) across a second, different access path.
not_established: No file bytes or metadata of the Freeman MRF were obtained; no absence or compliance conclusion is drawn.
interpretation: Domain-level evidence gain (freemanregional.com first-party site carries no MRF) plus a second-path access denial. Gate exact-file-access-and-campus-attribution remains unsatisfied; no disposition change.
